test_transformer_ranker_overfit: test the transformer ranker model by training it on an overfit integration task and checking hits at 1
test_transformer_generator_beamsearch: test the transformer generator model beam search inference with a pretrained model file and verify bleu scores
test_transformer_resize_embeddings: test that transformer generator embeddings are correctly resized when loading a model with special tokens
test_transformer_lr_scheduler_resume: test that the learning rate scheduler resumes correctly across training sessions for both generator and ranker models
test_transformer_swap_components: test swapping transformer encoder layer components like feedforward networks using the with_components API
